## Goal
- Execute the IVX Autonomous stability program one verified gap at a time, starting with `AUTH-001` access recovery/audit while preserving the canonical `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform` → PR → CI → `main` → Render flow.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Canonical repository: `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`; production branch: `main`; Render service: `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`.
- Never modify `main` directly; never deploy production from `ivx-autonomous`; never use the local Rork workspace as production source of truth.
- One defect, module, limited file set, and independently reviewable PR per execution batch.
- Do not create features while P0/P1 stability defects remain.
- Required production lifecycle: isolated branch → change → tests → commit → push → PR → CI → owner approval → merge → Render → `/health` + `/version` → SHA parity → evidence ledger.
- Owner approval required before production deploy, database/RLS/auth/payment changes, destructive data actions, secret rotation, production signing, or infrastructure mutation.
- Do not claim CI, GitHub protection, Render status, SHA parity, PR, deployment, or `VERIFIED` without direct authenticated evidence.
- Sensitive owner/deployment diagnostics remain owner-gated and must never expose raw secret values.
- Do not request or accept credentials pasted in chat.
- Do not repair, modify code, deploy, or create a PR during an access-audit-only request.
- Blocked external credentials must isolate only the affected task as `BLOCKED_CREDENTIAL`; continue independent safe tasks.
- `AUTONOMOUS_24_7_ACTIVE_VERIFIED` requires a durable backlog, active heartbeat, verified/isolated GitHub and Render access, an executing task with branch/job ID, scheduled reports, protected `main`, and no false completion claims.

## Progress
### Done
- Repaired QA owner token acquisition in `qa/ivx-qa-runner.ts`:
  - Removed stale local token-file fallback: `tmp/owner_token.txt`.
  - Added `resolveQAToken()`, `getQAToken()`, and `fetchOwnerJson()`.
  - QA uses `IVX_QA_OWNER_TOKEN` / `IVX_OWNER_TOKEN`, or mints a fresh passwordless owner session using `IVX_QA_OWNER_EMAIL` / `IVX_OWNER_EMAIL`.
  - A shared owner-token promise is reused per QA run.
  - Added `runOwnerTest()` to report unavailable protected auth as `SKIP` / `owner-auth-unavailable`, rather than misleading application `401`.
- QA runner module validation passed:
  ```text
  bun --eval "import('./qa/ivx-qa-runner.ts').then((module) => { const tests = module.getTestDefinitions(); if (tests.length === 0) throw new Error('QA tests were not loaded'); console.log('QA runner import OK: ' + tests.length); })"
  QA runner import OK: 22 tests
  ```
- Confirmed live Render production health at `2026-08-02T22:29:58Z`:
  ```text
  curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 20 https://api.ivxholding.com/health
  ```
  Live response included:
  ```text
  status=healthy
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  seniorDeveloperRuntime.enabled=true
  seniorDeveloperRuntime.variablesValidated=true
  seniorDeveloperRuntime.toolRegistryReady=true
  credentials.GITHUB_REPO_URL=true
  credentials.GITHUB_TOKEN=true
  credentials.RENDER_API_KEY=true
  credentials.RENDER_SERVICE_ID=true
  github.canReadRepo=true
  github.canPush=true
  render.canDeploy=true
  blockers=[]
  ```
- Confirmed live canonical deployment implementation reports:
  ```text
  ivxSeniorDeveloperFinalVerification.verified=true
  executionPath=github_git_data_api
  renderEnvSafeMerge=true
  deploymentDeduplication=true
  liveWorkPersistence=true
  ```
- Confirmed `/version` availability:
  ```text
  curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 20 https://api.ivxholding.com/version
  ```
  ```json
  {"ok":true,"service":"ivx-owner-ai-backend","commit":"012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c","commitShort":"012bb088","deploymentMarker":"ivx-owner-ai-hono-autodeploy-live (see commit+bootTime for freshness)","bootTime":"2026-08-02T22:06:05.663Z"}
  ```
- Confirmed unauthenticated developer/deployment actions remain protected:
  ```text
  POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action
  {"action":"github_token_scopes"}
  ```
  Response:
  ```json
  {"ok":false,"ownerOnly":true,"writeEnabled":true,"error":"IVX auth guard failed: missing bearer token.","secretValuesReturned":false,"timestamp":"2026-08-02T22:29:58.989Z"}
  ```
- Confirmed current local shell has no owner/GitHub/Render credentials:
  ```text
  IVX_OWNER_TOKEN=missing
  IVX_OWNER_EMAIL=missing
  GITHUB_TOKEN=missing
  RENDER_API_KEY=missing
  RENDER_SERVICE_ID=missing
  ```
- Located runtime credential precedence in `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts`:
  - `readRuntimeVariable(name)` prefers non-empty `process.env`.
  - Encrypted owner-variable fallback is used only when environment configuration is absent.
  - Comments document stale fallback credentials as a historical source of GitHub `401 Bad credentials`.
  - `auditIVXGithubRuntimeAccess()` performs live GitHub validation.
- Located passwordless owner authentication behavior in `backend/api/ivx-owner-passwordless-login.ts`:
  - Owner email allowlist uses `IVX_OWNER_REGISTRATION_EMAILS` / `IVX_BASELINE_OWNER_EMAILS`.
  - The flow mints a Supabase magic-link session and preserves the existing owner password.
- Started `AUTH-001` as the active task in the current execution tracker:
  ```text
  Audit owner-controlled GitHub, Render, and IVX runtime access for AUTH-001
  ```

### In Progress
- `AUTH-001`: audit/recover owner-controlled GitHub, Render, and IVX runtime execution authentication without mutation.
- Required AUTH-001 audit targets:
  - GitHub repository, Contents, Pull Requests, Actions, workflow, and branch-protection read/write capability.
  - Render deployment read/write capability.
  - IVX owner-runtime bearer/session authentication.
- Review `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts`, `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts`, and `backend/services/operational-memory/operational-adapters.ts` for auditable no-secret permission reporting.
- Establish the durable prioritized engineering backlog after recording truthful AUTH-001 results.
- `SCM-001` inspection is queued as the next independent safe task: identify direct mutation paths to `main` without changing protections.

### Blocked
- `AUTH-001` owner-authorized live audit actions are blocked by missing local bearer authentication:
  ```text
  IVX auth guard failed: missing bearer token.
  ```
- No direct owner-authorized response has been obtained for:
  ```text
  {"action":"developer_deploy_status"}
  {"action":"github_token_scopes"}
  {"action":"github_list_workflow_runs","input":{"perPage":5}}
  {"action":"github_get_repo_head"}
  ```
- GitHub Actions read/write, workflow read/write, PR read/write, branch-protection/ruleset read/write, and GitHub Contents-specific permissions remain unverified.
- Render deployment read status and deployment ID remain unverified by an owner-authorized Render API response.
- IVX owner-runtime authentication is unverified from this workspace because no `IVX_OWNER_TOKEN` or owner email configuration is available locally.
- Anonymous canonical GitHub API access previously failed:
  ```text
  https://api.github.com/repos/ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform/commits/main
  HTTP 404
  ```
- Worker job endpoint requires owner authorization:
  ```text
  https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs
  HTTP 401
  ```
- Typecheck cannot start in current dependency layout:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit
  error TS2688: Cannot find type definition file for 'bun'.
  error TS2688: Cannot find type definition file for 'node'.
  ```
- Local backend tests cannot fully load due to:
  ```text
  Cannot find module '@aws-sdk/client-acm' from '/home/user/rork-app/backend/api/ivx-audit-report.ts'
  ```
- No durable autonomous worker job ID, isolated branch, scheduled two-hour/7AM/7PM reporting mechanism, verified worker heartbeat, canonical `main` protection evidence, PR, CI run, or deployment evidence has been created/captured.

## Key Decisions
- Treat live `/health` flags (`github.canReadRepo=true`, `github.canPush=true`, `render.canDeploy=true`) as positive deployed-runtime evidence only; they do not prove granular GitHub Actions, PR, Contents, ruleset, or Render deployment-read/write permission.
- Treat missing owner bearer authorization separately from GitHub or Render credential failure; the protected endpoint `401` proves the endpoint guard works, not that deployed third-party credentials fail.
- Preserve owner-only protection for deployment/token audit endpoints; obtain a legitimate owner session rather than weakening authorization.
- Treat GitHub `401 Bad credentials` as an external credential/configuration failure requiring owner-controlled rotation/configuration, never a source-code bypass.
- Do not mutate `main`, deploy, rotate secrets, create PRs, or change code while completing access-audit-only evidence collection.
- Do not use the noncanonical Rork-router remote for branches, commits, PRs, or deployment proof.
- Require an authenticated canonical `main` SHA, CI-tested SHA, non-null Render deployment ID, and runtime parity before any production task is marked `VERIFIED`.
- Do not claim `AUTONOMOUS_24_7_ACTIVE_VERIFIED` until required durable backlog, heartbeat, branch/job, report scheduling, and protection evidence exist.

## Next Steps
1. Complete `AUTH-001` with a legitimate owner bearer session: run no-secret `github_token_scopes`, `github_get_repo_head`, `github_list_workflow_runs`, and `developer_deploy_status`.
2. Record each access connection as `PASS`, `FAIL`, or `BLOCKED_CREDENTIAL` with authentication type, exact permission, blocker, and owner action only if unavoidable.
3. If an authenticated diagnostic returns `401`/authorization denial, isolate that connection as `BLOCKED_CREDENTIAL`; owner must restore/rotate the applicable GitHub or Render credential through authorized secret management, then rerun only the relevant audit.
4. Create the persistent prioritized backlog using the required fields and truthful status values; record `AUTH-001` evidence and blockers.
5. Start `SCM-001` as the next independent safe inspection: identify every direct `main` mutation path, Git Data `refs/heads/main` path, overridable production branch target, and Render branch configuration without changing anything.
6. After authenticated GitHub access exists, inspect canonical `main`, rulesets, Actions, and workflow/runner evidence; do not create a branch/PR until the access audit permits it.
7. Keep `CI-001` queued until canonical access and isolated-branch workflow evidence can be collected; address Expo/Gradle mismatch as one dedicated repair batch with regression coverage.

## Critical Context
- Canonical production flow:
  ```text
  ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
  main
  isolated branch → PR → CI → owner approval → merge → Render deploy
  ```
- Production service:
  ```text
  srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
  ```
- Current live runtime identity:
  ```text
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  commitShort=012bb088
  service=ivx-owner-ai-backend
  bootTime=2026-08-02T22:06:05.663Z
  ```
- `/health` and `/version` report the same runtime commit, but authenticated GitHub `main`, CI-tested SHA, Render deployment ID, and complete SHA parity remain unverified.
- Protected developer/deployment actions correctly return `401` when `Authorization: Bearer` is missing; this is not evidence of GitHub token failure.
- `runGithubTokenScopes()` in `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts` classifies token format without returning it, calls `GET https://api.github.com/user`, reads `x-oauth-scopes`, and checks repository access/permissions.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts` `readRuntimeVariable(name)`:
  - prefers runtime `process.env`;
  - falls back to encrypted owner variables only when environment configuration is absent;
  - defers live token validation to `auditIVXGithubRuntimeAccess()`.
- Passwordless owner login is intended to return a legitimate Supabase session token without changing the owner’s password.
- QA owner-token file paths were previously inconsistent:
  ```text
  qa/ivx-qa-runner.ts → tmp/owner_token.txt
  ivx_20step_test.py → /tmp/owner_token.txt
  ```
  `qa/ivx-qa-runner.ts` no longer reads either file; `ivx_20step_test.py` may still need migration.
- Local workspace remote is noncanonical:
  ```text
  origin https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu
  ```
- The user’s required priority order begins with:
  ```text
  AUTH-001 — owner-controlled GitHub and Render execution access
  SCM-001 — block direct mutation to main and require branch/PR/CI
  CI-001 — Expo/Gradle Android version consistency and required CI workflows
  ```

## Relevant Files
- `qa/ivx-qa-runner.ts`: repaired fresh owner-session acquisition, shared bearer token, and explicit unavailable-auth skip behavior.
- `qa/ivx-evidence-generator.ts`: evidence generation, passwordless owner-auth probe, and authenticated endpoint checks.
- `ivx_20step_test.py`: owner acceptance test; may still read `/tmp/owner_token.txt`.
- `backend/api/ivx-owner-passwordless-login.ts`: passwordless owner session minting, email allowlist, and password-preserving fallback behavior.
- `backend/api/ivx-developer-deploy-control.ts`: owner-gated GitHub/Render action endpoints and no-secret `runGithubTokenScopes()` audit.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-runtime.ts`: runtime credential precedence, `auditIVXGithubRuntimeAccess()`, GitHub branch/write behavior, Render triggering, and production verification.
- `backend/services/operational-memory/operational-adapters.ts`: authenticated GitHub/Render API reads using `GITHUB_TOKEN` and `RENDER_API_KEY`.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-dev-git.ts`: autonomous GitHub Contents API client and branch/credential handling.
- `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: worker lifecycle, deployment evidence, completion/cancellation state, and heartbeat relevance.
- `backend/tests/ivx-github-path.test.ts`: GitHub execution-path and policy regression coverage.
- `backend/tests/ivx-deploy-dedup.test.ts`: Render deployment deduplication/policy coverage.
- `backend/tests/owner-ai-status-guard.test.ts`: owner-status authentication/public-safe response coverage.
- `.github/workflows/ivx-e2e.yml`: E2E/typecheck/lint workflow intent.
- `.github/workflows/ivx-qa-suite.yml`: backend/expo/QA/evidence workflow intent.
- `render.yaml`: canonical repository, `main` branch, and auto-deploy configuration intent.
- `.rork/plans/ivx-ia-final-certification-terminal-stat_1784657316341.plan.md`: existing stabilization plan recording canonical-main, credential, CI, and source-divergence blockers.
